messages:
sophia: Heads-up: launching a 2-week entitlement curation sprint next Mon 9AM PT. Goal: quarterly least-privilege audit, remove lingering admin/editor roles, reconcile KMS key bindings, and wire up structured audit events for any grant changes. Plan attached in the runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/entitlement-curation (WIP). Ping me with objections.
raj: Sounds good. Important: we should exclude service principals with KMS use in last 45d. I'll add that filter to the query.
leo: +1. Also propose a canary flow: staging -> perf smoke -> canary app traffic -> 24h observation before prod. Keep change batches small (<=10 principals).
sophia: Agreed. Canary criteria: no increase in 5xxs, no auth failures above baseline, and KMS error rate stable. If any fail, immediate rollback.
ops-bot: snapshot_created s3://redwood-entitlement/snapshots/1781234567 by @sophia
security-bot: Reminder: all manual revocations must include a `change_request_id` in audit log metadata for easy traceability. Example: `change_request_id=ECUR-2026-0421`
raj: Query I'll use to detect candidates (GCP example):
```
gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-prod --format=json 
| jq '.bindings[] | select(.role|test("roles/(owner|editor|admin)")) | {role: .role, principals: .members}'
```
raj: then cross-ref with KMS activity: `gcloud logging read "resource.type=kms_crypto_key AND protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail=\"PRINCIPAL\"" --limit 1`
leo: For rollback scripts: `./scripts/entitlements/restore --snapshot 1781234567 --dry-run` and we have `--apply` for real. Keep dry-run as the default in schedules.
sophia: Notification policy: create tickets in ENG-SEC with links to owners and a 48h review window. After 48h auto-schedule for revocation. We will still allow infra exceptions via the `entitlement-curation-exempt` group (timeboxed).
raj: One edgecase: delegated roles across projects. We'll need to preserve cross-project service bindings if they are used by dataflow/ops pipelines. Add an allowlist check for running jobs.
leo: Good call — add `running_jobs_count==0` to gate before revocation.
security-bot: Also ensure KMS grant changes produce structured audit entries. Suggested fields: `actor`, `target_principal`, `old_role`, `new_role`, `change_request_id`, `snapshot_ref`.
sophia: I'll update the runbook to include the audit schema + example event payload. Also scheduling: staging canary Wed 10AM PT, prod rollouts start Fri 1PM PT (staggered).
ops-bot: retention_policy set to 120d for /entitlement-curation/logs by @sophia
raj: One more: throttling. Don't exceed 5 revocations/minute to avoid hitting IAM quota. Add jitter and backoff in the job.
leo: I'll open the PR for the job and include the dry-run/metrics export. Who wants to own post-mortem if anything flares?
sophia: @raj take first-oncall. If anything escalates to infra-impacting incident, page eng-oncall and include the change_request_id in the incident notes.
raj: noted. I'll also export a short CSV of affected principals before and after for audit evidence.
sophia: Great. Thanks all. I'll post a short announcement to #all-hands tomorrow and create the ENG-SEC ticket template. :rocket:
